ns2:course.label: Models of Decision and Choice
ns2:course.description: Survey of mathematical and other formal models of human judgment and decision processes. Emphasizes differences between normative and descriptive models. Same as ACCY 595 and PS 528. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: PSYC 407.
